text: I think one of the problems today with the cities is Federal aid
speaker: REAGAN

text: The mayors that I've talked to in some of our leading cities tell! me that the Federal grants that come with. for a specific cause or a specific objective, come with such red tape, such priorities established by a bureaucracy in Washington, that the local government's hands are tied with regard to using that money as they feel could best be used, and for what they think might be the top priority
speaker: REAGAN

text: If they had that money without those government restrictions, every one of them has told me they could make great savings and make far greater use of the money
speaker: REAGAN
